answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before trading, like a ship paying to dock at a wharf: the deposit returns only after honest behavior, while a jury of randomly chosen peers can slash it on proven fraud. One identity costs little, but a Sybil farm must fund each fake separately, so its total stake grows linearly while its chance of passing review falls. At the zenith of abuse, the attacker loses every deposit plus the work spent building each cipher-keyed reputation, making mass fakery unprofitable.
